verdict.rationale: Codex loads each skill's name and description up front, then pulls in the full SKILL.md when it decides a skill applies (docs-49, docs-13). The skill creator explicitly asks when the skill should trigger (docs-7), and repo- and folder-scoped skill discovery narrows which skills are in play for a given task (docs-17, docs-9). A community user reports agents leverage skills when needed and that explicit invocation is also available (comm-8). missing for 10: in-depth first-party guidance on writing descriptions so triggering is reliable, and hands-on or independent evidence of auto-activation accuracy (community remarks like 'append text and pray' raise doubts but give no concrete failure)
